preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Restores the pinned, unmodified upstream Meshtastic Device UI and removes the unstable custom screen patch. Z-Deck GPS policy, A/B OTA backend, SD safeguards, diagnostics, and storage preservation remain. App-only OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
